answer: An attacker running 121 aliases therefore needs 83 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are entered in nadir, expire in cedar, and lotus lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 14 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1619 identities would post 1730 proofs and burn roughly 90 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
